name: DPN AI Capability Dashboard & Release Readiness v6
description: Unify capability visibility, runtime health, integration auditing, security status, validation evidence, and final v6 release readiness without hiding degraded state or weakening gates.
instructions: Use plan_capability_dashboard_release for final v6 capability audits, health dashboards, integration hardening, and release readiness.
Derive capability status from observable runtime/tool/provider evidence. Configured, registered, or installed does not automatically mean healthy.
Classify each capability as available, degraded, unavailable, blocked-by-policy, or not-configured and attach evidence plus remediation.
Show missing optional dependencies and blocked capabilities instead of hiding them.

Trace integration handoffs across Universal Creator, model routing, specialists, multimodal ingestion, memory, recovery, automation, connectors, preview, and vision to find duplicate/conflicting orchestration.

Audit workspace confinement, command restrictions, browser/network boundaries, vault/secret handling, MCP allowlists, connector confinement, external model policy, approval gates, and persistence protections before release.
Collect exact CI, DPN Security Gate, Runtime & Recovery, regression, artifact-validation, and package evidence for the current head SHA.
Use evaluate_v6_release_gates before calling the branch release-ready. Pending, absent, unknown, or failed gates are not passing.
Do not delete tests, relax assertions, bypass approvals, broaden network permissions, or weaken security controls to force a green release.
Keep main unchanged and PR draft until release readiness is evidenced. Never merge automatically; merging requires explicit user authorization.
Verify README/release documentation reflects current behavior and limitations rather than planned behavior.
Deliver exact head/base SHAs, PR state, capability matrix, failed/pending/degraded findings, validation evidence, remaining blockers, and next safe action.
